headline: Last session: Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 powered by banking stocks and foreign inflows.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Strong buying in banking stocks led the benchmark rally.
Foreign inflows provided crucial support to the market momentum.
IT stocks helped power a midday recovery following an early slump.
NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their winning streak to four straight weeks with 3% gains.
whatHappening: Sensex jumped 898 points while Nifty successfully reclaimed the 25,800 mark.
Markets had opened lower initially following a global AI selloff.
Nifty Smallcap 100 underperformed relative to the main benchmark indices over the week.
Traders are checking holiday schedules ahead of Guru Nanak Jayanti on Tuesday, November 24.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp rally, with the Sensex surging 898 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,800.
The gain was driven by strength in banking and IT stocks alongside positive foreign capital inflows, overcoming an early morning dip caused by global AI selloff concerns.
With these gains, both Sensex and Nifty extended their weekly winning streak to four weeks.
